# S3 Uploader

The Apify actor [`apify/s3-uploader`](https://apify.com/apify/s3-uploader) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.6**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Upload data from an Apify dataset to an Amazon S3 bucket. Providing various filters and transformation options, this Actor allows precise control over data structure, formatting, and upload settings to ensure seamless integration into your data pipeline.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/s3-uploader) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-s3-uploader@0.0.6#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      accessKeyId: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessKeyId` | string | yes |  | Access key ID — Your AWS access key ID used for authorization of the upload. You can get it from *AWS Console* -> *IAM* -> *Users* -> *Create user / Select existing user* -> *Security credentials* -> *Access keys*. |
| `secretAccessKey` | string | yes |  | Secret access key — Your AWS secret access key used for authorization of the upload. You can get it from *AWS Console* -> *IAM* -> *Users* -> *Create user / Select existing user* -> *Security credentials* -> *Access keys* -> *Create access key*. The secret access key will be displayed only once, upo |
| `region` | string | yes |  | Region — The AWS region where the target S3 bucket is located. You can get it from *AWS Console* -> *S3* -> *Create bucket / Select existing bucket* -> *Properties*. |
| `bucket` | string | yes |  | Bucket — The name of the target S3 bucket. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | Key — The object key, which serves as an identifier for the uploaded data in the S3 bucket. It can include an optional prefix. If an object with the same key already exists, it will be overwritten with the uploaded data. |
| `datasetId` | string | yes |  | Dataset ID — The Apify dataset ID from which data will be retrieved for the upload. |
| `format` | string |  | `"json"` | Format — The format of the uploaded data. |
| `fields` | array |  |  | Select — Fields to include in the output. If not specified, all fields will be included. |
| `omit` | array |  |  | Omit — Fields to exclude from the output. |
| `unwind` | array |  |  | Unwind fields — Fields to unwind. If the field is an array, every element will become a separate record and merged with the parent object. If the unwound field is an object, it is merged with the parent object. If the unwound field is missing or its value is neither an array nor an object, it cannot |
| `flatten` | array |  |  | Flatten fields — Fields to transform from nested objects into a flat structure. |
| `offset` | integer |  |  | Offset — Number of items to skip from the beginning of the dataset. |
| `limit` | integer |  |  | Limit — Maximum number of items to upload. |
| `clean` | boolean |  | `true` | Clean only — If enabled, only clean dataset items and their non-hidden fields will be uploaded. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
